content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I would like to know if it's possible to adjust the block size in the program so that diagrams appear larger when printing from A4 to A3 paper. Thank you. [user_name]
To set up the page, select A3 as the paper format. You can also adjust the zoom (for example, to 71%) in the print settings before printing.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is asking how to increase the size of printed diagrams when changing from A4 to A3 paper, specifically by adjusting block size. Another user suggests changing page setup and zoom settings but doesn't confirm direct block resizing within the program, reflecting possible uncertainty regarding print scaling options.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for a feature within the program that allows printed diagrams to be resized or scaled up automatically when switching from A4 to A3.
